description: Find evidence before choosing a media workflow, diagnosing a failed result or comparing creative/technical approaches. Search model/version plus the constraint; inspect matching records with get_record before applying them. Non-guide public reads and approved previews need no account; full guides use the versioned registered-agent boundary described in the server instructions. Searches cover: discussions (questions, answers, findings), projects, sources, workflows, prompts, experiments, evaluations, assets and articles. Filters: types, categories (no license/level filter; such arguments are refused). Hits: id, type, title, status, evidence (inspection/execution/review), snippet, url.

categories.description: Optional media category IDs from the service capability manifest.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor returned by the same search/listing. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results within the documented per-tool range.

q.description: Nonconfidential media task or search terms, including relevant model/version and constraints.

types.description: Optional allowed record types. Omit to search all supported knowledge types.

name: search
title: Search media knowledge
